title: Unpatched Apache Log4j vulnerability on application servers
description: Apache Log4j versions prior to 2.17.1 remain deployed on RHEL application servers, exposing the environment to remote code execution via crafted JNDI lookup strings. CVE-2021-44228 and related variants have not been fully remediated across all application tiers.
milestoneNotes: Patch deployment blocked by vendor compatibility testing. Third-party application vendor has not yet certified Log4j 2.17.1 for their product.

title: MFA not enforced for privileged administrator accounts
description: Multi-factor authentication is not configured for administrator accounts on the primary identity provider, creating risk of credential-based attack. Privileged accounts with domain admin rights can authenticate with password only.
milestoneNotes: MFA enforcement policy deployed to all privileged accounts. Hardware tokens distributed to all administrators. Validation testing completed successfully.

title: Audit logs not retained for minimum 90-day period
description: System audit logs on Windows 11 workstations are configured with a 30-day retention period, falling short of the 90-day minimum required by organizational policy and NIST guidelines. Log rotation overwrites critical forensic data.
milestoneNotes: Group policy updated to enforce 90-day retention. SIEM integration confirmed receiving logs. Compliance validated across all OU workstations.

title: Remote access not encrypted with FIPS 140-2 compliant algorithms
description: VPN connections to the AWS production environment are configured with non-FIPS validated cryptographic modules. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 remain enabled on remote access gateways, violating federal encryption requirements.
milestoneNotes: FIPS-compliant module procurement approved. Awaiting deployment window coordination with operations team. TLS 1.0/1.1 deprecation notice sent to all system owners.

title: Firewall rules permit unrestricted outbound traffic
description: Palo Alto firewall cluster permits outbound traffic on all ports without application-level inspection. Egress filtering is not enforced, allowing potential data exfiltration through non-standard ports and protocols.
milestoneNotes: Phase 1 egress rules deployed for web and email traffic. Phase 2 covering database and application tier ports scheduled for next maintenance window.

title: Database backups not encrypted at rest
description: Oracle database cluster backups stored on network-attached storage are not encrypted using AES-256 or equivalent. Backup files contain sensitive PII and financial data accessible to storage administrators without additional access controls.
milestoneNotes: Oracle TDE enabled for all production databases. RMAN backup encryption configured with AES-256. Validation test restored encrypted backup successfully.

title: Privileged accounts lack session timeout enforcement
description: Administrative sessions on Active Directory domain controllers do not enforce automatic session lock after 15 minutes of inactivity. Unattended privileged sessions create risk of unauthorized access in shared server room environments.
milestoneNotes: GPO enforcing 15-minute session lock deployed to all domain controllers. Screen saver password requirement enabled. Testing confirmed policy enforcement across all DCs.

title: Security awareness training completion below 95% threshold
description: Annual cybersecurity awareness training completion rate is at 78% across the organization, below the 95% threshold required by policy. Multiple business units have not completed phishing simulation exercises within the required timeframe.
milestoneNotes: Reminder notifications sent to non-compliant personnel. Training deadline extension granted to field offices. Current completion rate at 87%.

title: Vulnerability scanning not performed on all network segments
description: Automated vulnerability scanning coverage excludes the DMZ and management network segments. Approximately 15% of network-connected assets are not included in the weekly scanning schedule, leaving blind spots in vulnerability visibility.
milestoneNotes: Scanner appliance deployed to DMZ segment. Management VLAN scan credentials provisioned. Full coverage validation testing in progress.

title: Configuration baseline not established for virtual infrastructure
description: VMware vSphere environment lacks a documented and enforced security configuration baseline. ESXi host hardening has not been validated against DISA STIG requirements, and configuration drift detection is not automated.
milestoneNotes: DISA STIG for VMware vSphere 7 downloaded and review initiated. Baseline document draft at 60% completion. Ansible playbook for automated compliance checking under development.

title: Incident response plan not tested within 12-month period
description: The organization has not conducted a tabletop exercise or functional test of the incident response plan within the last 12 months. IR team roles and escalation procedures have not been validated since the last organizational restructuring.
milestoneNotes: Tabletop exercise scenario drafted and approved by CISO. Exercise scheduled for next quarter. External facilitator contract under review.

title: USB mass storage devices not restricted on workstations
description: Group policy does not block USB mass storage device connections on Windows 11 workstations. Users can connect personal USB drives, creating data exfiltration and malware introduction risks in the controlled environment.
milestoneNotes: GPO for USB device restriction tested in pilot OU. Exception process for approved devices documented. Enterprise-wide deployment pending change advisory board approval.

title: Personnel security screening not completed for contractors
description: Background investigation records are missing or expired for 12 contractor personnel with access to sensitive systems. Position risk designations have not been reviewed for contractor roles following the annual reassessment cycle.
milestoneNotes: All contractor background investigations completed or renewed. Position risk designations updated for all contractor roles. Tracking spreadsheet transitioned to automated HR workflow.

title: System security plan missing required control implementations
description: The System Security Plan for the AWS production environment is missing detailed control implementation statements for 23 of 325 applicable controls. Several inherited control designations lack supporting documentation from the cloud service provider.
milestoneNotes: 18 of 23 missing control implementation statements drafted. AWS shared responsibility matrix reviewed and inherited controls documented. Final review by ISSO scheduled.

title: Network time synchronization not configured for all systems
description: Multiple systems across the environment are not synchronized to the authoritative NTP source. Time drift of up to 5 minutes has been observed between domain controllers and application servers, impacting audit log correlation accuracy.
milestoneNotes: NTP hierarchy reconfigured with PDC emulator as authoritative source. All member servers and workstations validated for time sync. Monitoring alert configured for drift exceeding 1 second.

title: Maintenance tools not controlled on production servers
description: Unauthorized diagnostic and maintenance utilities (nmap, Wireshark, PuTTY portable) found installed on RHEL application servers. Software installation controls do not prevent privileged users from deploying unapproved tools.
milestoneNotes: Unauthorized tools removed from 8 of 12 servers. Application whitelisting policy drafted. SELinux module for software installation restriction under testing.

title: Critical VMware ESXi vulnerability unpatched across cluster
description: CVE-2024-37085 affecting VMware ESXi hypervisors remains unpatched across the vSphere cluster. This vulnerability allows Active Directory group manipulation to gain full administrative access to ESXi hosts without proper authorization.
milestoneNotes: Patch tested in development cluster. Production maintenance window requested but denied due to fiscal year-end freeze. Compensating control implemented via AD group restriction.

title: Lack of encrypted communications for database replication
description: Oracle Data Guard replication traffic between primary and standby database servers traverses the internal network unencrypted. Sensitive data including PII is transmitted in cleartext between data centers during synchronization.
milestoneNotes: Oracle Advanced Security license procured. TLS configuration for Data Guard transport tested in staging environment. Production cutover planned for next maintenance window.

title: Supply chain risk assessment not performed for critical vendors
description: Formal supply chain risk assessments have not been conducted for 5 of 8 critical technology vendors. Vendor security questionnaires and third-party audit reports have not been collected or reviewed per the supply chain risk management policy.
milestoneNotes: Vendor risk assessment questionnaire template finalized. Questionnaires sent to 3 of 5 remaining vendors. Two vendors have responded; reviews in progress.

title: PII data mapping and inventory not current
description: The organization's PII inventory and data flow mapping have not been updated to reflect system changes implemented in the last fiscal year. New data collection forms and third-party data sharing agreements are not reflected in privacy documentation.
milestoneNotes: Data flow mapping workshop completed with system owners. PII inventory spreadsheet updated for 3 of 7 systems. Privacy impact assessment revision initiated.

title: Physical access logs not reviewed monthly
description: Physical access control system logs for the primary data center are not being reviewed on a monthly basis as required by the physical security policy. Anomalous after-hours access events have accumulated without investigation for the past four months.
milestoneNotes: Monthly review process documented and assigned to facility security officer. Backlog of 4 months of logs under review. Automated alerting for after-hours access being configured.

title: Service account passwords not rotated per policy
description: Service accounts used for application-to-application authentication on Active Directory have not had passwords rotated within the 90-day policy window. Fourteen service accounts have passwords older than 180 days.
milestoneNotes: 8 of 14 service account passwords rotated. Remaining accounts require application team coordination for credential update. Group Managed Service Accounts migration planned.

title: Information system backup procedures not documented
description: Backup and recovery procedures for the Oracle database cluster lack formal documentation. Recovery time objectives and recovery point objectives are not defined, and backup restoration has not been tested within the last 12 months.
milestoneNotes: Backup procedure document template obtained from IT governance. DBA team conducting inventory of current backup configurations across all database instances.

title: Wireless intrusion detection system not deployed
description: No wireless intrusion detection or prevention capability exists to identify rogue access points or unauthorized wireless connections within the facility perimeter. Periodic manual surveys are conducted but do not provide continuous monitoring.
milestoneNotes: Risk acceptance memorandum signed by AO. Compensating control: quarterly manual wireless surveys conducted by security team. Re-evaluation scheduled for FY26 budget cycle.

title: Security assessment report findings not tracked to closure
description: Findings from the most recent annual security assessment have not been formally tracked in the POA&M register. Twelve assessment findings remain unaddressed without assigned responsible parties or milestone dates.
milestoneNotes: Assessment findings being decomposed into individual POA&M items. Responsible POCs identified for 8 of 12 findings. Milestone dates under negotiation with system owners.

title: Continuous monitoring strategy document outdated
description: The organization's continuous monitoring strategy has not been updated to reflect the current threat landscape and technology environment. Monitoring frequencies, automated tool configurations, and reporting requirements do not align with current NIST guidelines.
milestoneNotes: Risk accepted pending FY26 strategic planning cycle. Current monitoring tools continue to operate under existing configuration. Strategy update included in FY26 project portfolio.

title: Deprecated TLS cipher suites enabled on web servers
description: RHEL application servers hosting public-facing web applications still support TLS CBC-mode cipher suites vulnerable to BEAST and Lucky13 attacks. Cipher suite configuration has not been updated to enforce TLS 1.3-only connections.
milestoneNotes: Cancelled — superseded by POAM-2025-012 which addresses comprehensive TLS hardening across all server platforms. Findings consolidated to avoid duplicate remediation efforts.

title: System interconnection agreements not current
description: Interconnection Security Agreements and Memoranda of Understanding for three external system connections have expired. Data exchange with partner agencies continues without current authorization documentation governing security responsibilities.
milestoneNotes: All three ISAs renewed and signed by both parties. MOU for partner agency data exchange updated with current security requirements. Documents filed in authorization package.
